name: El Árbol

candle-warm key; the visitor carries the light
celeste withheld from the entire palette until a release is earned
Chivo for engraved plaque capitals, Alegreya for votive text

prompt: El Santuario, first viewport, desktop 1440x900. The shrine as one mass the visitor orbits: a bare tree in near-silhouette against warm black, its canopy hung with hundreds of Gauchito-red ribbons falling in a dense curtain, plaques wired into the branches, and offerings heaped at the base -- water bottles, tin charms, three lit candles. A faint elliptical orbit ring on the ground states the radial topology. Chivo engraved capitals. Celeste absent.
